rows.excerpt:
Do not fail packaging if repo info is absent

As part of a process to build a BOSH release, I encountered the error
below while running `./mvnw package`:

```
[ERROR] Failed to execute goal pl.project13.maven:git-commit-id-plugin:3.0.1:revision (default) on project spring-petclinic: Could not complete Mojo execution...: Error: Could not get HEAD Ref, are you sure you have set the dotGitDirectory property of this plugin to a valid path? -> [Help 1]
[ERROR]
[ERROR] To see the full stack trace of the errors, re-run Maven with the -e switch.
[ERROR] Re-run Maven using the -X switch to enable full debug logging.
[ERROR]
[ERROR] For more information about the errors and possible solutions, please read the following articles:
[ERROR] [Help 1] http://cwiki.apache.org/confluence/display/MAVEN/MojoExecutionException
```

That's because we are just interested on the source files for the BOSH
release, we don't care about repo metadata (so we exclude them).

Going through the [git-commit-id-maven-plugin
docs](https://github.com/git-commit-id/git-commit-id-maven-plugin/blob/master/maven/docs/using-the-plugin.md)
we learned it is possible to prevent the failure above via
configuration.

We propose then to set
`<failOnUnableToExtractRepoInfo>false</failOnUnableToExtractRepoInfo>`,
enabling use cases similar to ours.

FWIW `failOnNoGitDirectory` is already set to false.

rows.title: Feature: Add Medical History Tracking for Pets
rows.excerpt:
## User Story

**As a** pet owner,  
**I want to** view and manage the medical history of my pet (such as diagnoses, treatments, and vaccines),  
**So that** I can track its health status and vaccination history over time.

---

## Acceptance Criteria 

### Viewing Medical History

**Given** a pet with existing medical records  
**When** I navigate to the pet's profile page  
**Then** I should see a list of all diagnoses, treatments, and vaccinations recorded

---

### Adding a New Medical Record

**Given** I am on the medical record creation form for a pet  
**When** I fill in the diagnosis, treatment, vaccine, and date fields and submit  
**Then** a new medical record should be saved and associated with the selected pet

---

### Validation

**Given** I leave required fields empty  
**When** I try to submit the form  
**Then** I should see validation messages and the record should not be saved

---

## Notes
- This feature will require extending the data model by introducing a new `MedicalRecord` entity.
- UI support may include listing medical records on the pet detail page and a form to add a new record.
- Spring Data JPA will be used to handle the entity relationships.

rows.title: Deploy Pipeline
rows.excerpt:
.sh, 07-provision-vm.sh): a Vagrant-managed Ubuntu 22.04 VM. Provider/box are auto-detected per host so the
  same scripts work on Apple Silicon (QEMU, since VirtualBox has no real arm64-Linux-guest support there), Intel Mac, and Linux (VirtualBox) — this is what makes it re-runnable regardless of where the
  repo is cloned.
  - Ansible control node (devops/docker-compose.deploy.yml, devops/docker/ansible-control/Dockerfile, devops/scripts/08-configure-ansible-control.sh): a small sidecar container on the existing
  petclinic-devops-net network, reached by Jenkins via docker exec/docker cp (same sibling-container pattern already used for Jenkins↔SonarQube). Its inventory/SSH key are generated automatically from
  vagrant ssh-config.
  - Deploy playbook (devops/ansible/playbooks/deploy.yml + templates/petclinic.service.j2): installs a JRE 17 (matches pom.xml's java.version), creates a dedicated petclinic user, and runs the app as a
  petclinic.service systemd unit on port 8080.
  - Single deploy script (devops/scripts/09-deploy-app.sh): builds the jar if needed and deploys it — used both by a human running it manually and by the Jenkinsfile's Deploy stage, so manual and CI
  deploys behave identically.
  - Teardown (devops/scripts/10-teardown-vm.sh): symmetric cleanup (halt or fully destroy the VM).
  - pom.xml: added **/.vagrant/**/* and devops/ansible/files/**/* to the existing nohttp-checkstyle excludes — the Vagrant-managed VM disk image was tripping that check since it embeds http:// URLs from
  the guest OS's own package lists.
  - devops/ANSIBLE-DEPLOYMENT-SETUP.md: setup/troubleshooting doc in the same style as JENKINS-PIPELINE-SETUP.md.

  Known limitations   

  - Requires nested virtualization (won't work inside another VM or most containerized CI runners).
  - 06-install-vm-prerequisites.sh installs packages via Homebrew/apt but assumes those package managers are already present.
  - The arm64 Vagrant box (perk/ubuntu-2204-arm64) is best-effort on Vagrant Cloud; override with VM_BOX if needed.
